title: Repo Ops
subtitle: Repository operations
description: Review every branch in this repository and clean up the ones you no longer need with a reviewed, confirmed delete.

error.heading: Could not load branches
error.description: GitHub returned an error while scanning branches. Check your connection in Settings.

empty.heading: No branches found
empty.description: No branches match your search, or this repository doesn't have any yet.

table.selectAll: Select all branches on this page

signalTooltips.mergedViaPr: This branch's changes were merged into another branch through a pull request.
signalTooltips.unreferencedByReleases: This branch is not used as the base or compare ref of any release in this project.
signalTooltips.openPr: This branch is the head of an open pull request. Click to open it on GitHub.

protected.shieldLabel: This branch is protected from deletion

reasonDescription.DEFAULT_BRANCH: This is the repository's default branch. It can never be deleted.
reasonDescription.GITHUB_PROTECTED: This branch has GitHub branch protection enabled. It can never be deleted from here.
reasonDescription.OPEN_PULL_REQUEST: This branch is the head of an open pull request.
reasonDescription.RECENT_ACTIVITY: This branch has a commit within the last 30 days. Someone may still be working on it.
reasonDescription.PROTECTED_NAME: This branch name (main, master, dev, or develop) is treated as protected by convention.
reasonDescription.MANUALLY_BLOCKED: This branch was manually blocked from cleanup by a project member. Unblock it to make it deletable.
reasonDescription.RELEASE_REFERENCED: This branch is used as the base or compare ref of a release in this project.

unprotectDialog.title: Unprotect "{{branchName}}"?
unprotectDialog.description: This branch is protected for the reasons below. Overriding removes that protection for this session only.
unprotectDialog.acknowledge: I understand the risks and want to make this branch selectable for deletion.
unprotectDialog.confirmDescription: "{{branchName}}" will become selectable for deletion. You'll still need to confirm the delete separately.

cleanAll.title: Clean all branches
cleanAll.description: Every branch is analyzed before anything happens. Review exactly what will be deleted and what will be kept — protected branches are never touched.
cleanAll.loading: Analyzing every branch in the repository...
cleanAll.error: Could not build the cleanup plan. Try again.
cleanAll.executionError: The deletion was interrupted. Review the results below and retry if needed.
cleanAll.nothingToDelete: There is nothing safe to delete — every branch is protected.
cleanAll.confirmWarning_one: You are about to permanently delete {{count}} branch from GitHub. This cannot be undone.
cleanAll.confirmWarning_other: You are about to permanently delete {{count}} branches from GitHub. This cannot be undone.

block.dialogDescription: "{{branchName}}" will be excluded from cleanup suggestions and deletion until you unblock it.
block.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. keeping for a hotfix reference
block.error: Could not block this branch. Try again.

unblock.dialogDescription: This branch will become eligible for cleanup suggestions and deletion again.
unblock.error: Could not unblock this branch. Try again.

delete.dialogDescription_one: You're about to permanently delete {{count}} branch from GitHub. This cannot be undone.
delete.dialogDescription_other: You're about to permanently delete {{count}} branches from GitHub. This cannot be undone.
